title: Customer escalation runbook and per-tenant retry-cohort toggle
creator: Lena Morris
description: Summary: During two recent customer escalations we observed amplified retries from client SDKs combined with ephemeral model slowpaths causing sustained 5xx/timeouts for specific tenants. This ticket defines a playbook (runbook) and implements a short-lived, operator-controlled per-tenant retry-cohort toggle that can be flipped during escalations to limit amplification while we perform deeper fixes.
impact: Some customers experienced timeouts and elevated error rates (5xx) for periods ranging from 6 to 48 minutes. The pattern is correlated with large concurrent multipart uploads, SDK aggressive retries, and intermittent long tail model decoding on a subset of Dedicated-hosted model variants. Customer-facing incidents increased support load and required manual reroutes.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Simulate a tenant with high concurrent streaming requests (>= 200 concurrent streams) using SDK v2.3 with default retry policy
2) Trigger a model variant slowpath by sending long-sequence inputs that hit kv-cache eviction thresholds
3) Observe proxy-level 502/504 bubbling, backpressure at frontdoor, and client-side retry amplification within 30s
4) Verify that per-tenant circuit counts increase and the tenant enters retry storm state leading to downstream queue saturation.
proposed_fix: Implement a per-tenant retry-cohort toggle that moves a tenant into a conservative retry cohort during escalations. Changes: (a) server-side toggle gate in frontdoor to cap client-visible retries and downgrade retryable codes to transient throttles, (b) add a short TTL hysteresis so toggles do not oscillate, (c) surface toggle state in the Console (tenant status) and event logs, (d) guidance for Solutions to flip toggle during customer bridge and engage mitigation. This is intended as an operator safety valve while long-term fixes (batching/kvcache resiliency and SDK retry alignment) are completed.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Feature flag behind ops-only flag in staging with end-to-end e2e test harness (1 week). Phase 2: Deploy to canary region and enable for internal tenant to validate metrics (48h). Phase 3: Expose toggle to oncall UI and add runbook steps (2 days). Phase 4: Global rollout for ops with soft default off; enable during customer escalations only (immediate ops usage).
testing_plan: Unit tests for toggle gating logic and TTL hysteresis
Integration test that verifies capped retry response semantics under simulated client retries
Load test that validates no increased latency for non-target tenants
Chaos test: flip toggle repeatedly in staging to confirm no state leakage
rollback_plan: Operator can flip toggle off from Console immediately. If toggle causes unexpected customer-visible regressions, revert code path via feature flag kill switch and follow incident rollback playbook. Post-rollback, gather traces and metrics and escalate to runtime team for root cause analysis.
postmortem_actions: 1) Collect traces for two escalations and annotate where toggle would have reduced amplification
2) Prioritize SDK retry tuning work (ENG-601010) and kvcache eviction improvements (ENG-582111),
3) Add tenant heatmap to Console to detect pre-escalation signals and auto-notify oncall
4) Update runbook with exact thresholds and examples for Solutions to use during customer bridge
